views.rationale: capitalized software costs fell to $75 million in Q2 2018 from $111 million in Q2 2017, reducing expense pressure
revenues rose to $47.64 billion for six months ended June 30 2018, up from $45.01 billion a year earlier, and operating margin improved to 11.7% from 10.5%
second‑quarter 2018 sales were $14.011 billion, a 24% increase versus $11.331 billion in Q2 2017
total segment earnings for six months ended June 30 2018 were $8.213 billion versus $4.491 billion in 2017, and net income rose to $7.047 billion from $3.409 billion
Revenue grew 26% YoY to $32.7 billion, with constant‑currency growth of 23%
BBB‑rated credit exposure rose to 17% from 10% YoY, indicating higher risk
Worldwide sales rose 11.6% YoY to $40.8 billion, with operational growth of 8.6%
Self‑insurance reserves fell to $430 million from $480 million, reducing liability exposure
